title: Kestrel and the Choir
author: Freya Delacroix
blurb: Odile Almeida, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
